name: Kling 3.0
tagline: Cinematic AI video generator with native 15s clips and 4K visuals
description: Kling 3.0 is an all-in-one cinematic AI video generator. It produces native 15 second clips with 4K visuals, keeping camera moves, subjects and lighting in one continuous generation instead of stitching fragments together. The site covers key features, use cases and showcase reels, so teams can judge output quality before adopting it in a production workflow.
